Who We Are
Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation.  For more information, please visit solera.com.
The Role
We are looking for a Data Engineer who will be a key member of the Service Delivery team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and data products that support analytics and operational decision-making across the organisation.
This role is critical in ensuring data is reliable, accessible, and aligned to business needs, working across a variety of data sources and platforms to deliver high-quality, production-ready solutions.
The successful candidate will have strong technical expertise combined with excellent communication and problem-solving skills. They must be comfortable working across teams, translating requirements into robust technical solutions, and managing data pipelines end-to-end.
Pragmatic, data-driven, detail-oriented, and self-motivated are essential traits for success in this role, along with a mindset focused on scalability, reliability, and continuous improvement.
What You’ll Do
- Design, build, and operate end‑to‑end ETL/ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, and serving layers.
- Architect scalable, reusable data pipelines and frameworks that balance performance, cost, and reliability.
- Implement incremental loads, schema evolution, and data contracts to ensure stable, production‑grade pipelines.
- Monitor and maintain pipelines, including logging, validation, alerting, and incident response.
- Collaborate closely with BI, analysts, and architects to ensure datasets meet business requirements, SLAs, and reporting needs.
- Lead complex incident investigations and root‑cause analysis, driving remediation and prevention.
- Review and improve code, pipelines, and models to ensure quality, maintainability, and reuse.
- Translate requirements into technical designs with clear constraints, SLAs, and acceptance criteria.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to standards, patterns, and best practices across the team.
What You’ll Bring
- Strong ownership mindset: ability to move from task execution > pipeline ownership > system design accountability.
- Ability to balance scale, latency, cost, and governance when making design decisions.
- Solid communication skills to:
- Explain technical trade‑offs clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders
- Provide proactive updates on risks, changes, and dependencies
- Align teams across engineering, BI, and business domains
- Structured and proactive working style:
- Deliver maintainable solutions with strong documentation and observability
- Identify issues early and escalate appropriately
- Drive continuous improvement in reliability and engineering practices
- Strong problem-solving capability:
- Diagnose complex failures and data issues systematically
- Build reusable patterns to reduce duplication and operational load
- Mentoring mindset:
- Guide junior engineers
- Improve team quality through reviews, standards, and shared practices
Technical Skills
- Data Modelling: Designs analytical data models for multiple consumers, understands schemas, keys, and data grain, and balances normalisation versus performance using established and reusable modelling patterns.
- Data Governance: Embeds governance into pipeline and data model design, including lineage, traceability, ownership, and data quality rules, while ensuring alignment with data classification and compliance requirements.
- ETL / Data Engineering: Designs, builds, and operates end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines, including incremental processing, idempotent patterns, and schema evolution, with a focus on scalability and reliability.
- Development (SQL / Python): Writes clean, optimised SQL and scalable Python code, applying modular design, logging, testing, and code review practices, while considering performance and scalability trade-offs.
- Data Products / BI Integration: Designs and delivers datasets and data products with clearly defined SLAs, ensuring compatibility with BI tools and alignment with reporting and analytics requirements.
- Data Quality & Testing: Implements automated validation, schema checks, and monitoring, and leads investigations into data quality issues to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.
- Architecture & Scalability: Makes informed design decisions across batch vs streaming and ETL vs ELT approaches, building reusable, scalable components that improve platform efficiency and reliability.
- Security & Governance: Applies security-by-design principles, including access controls, data masking, and compliance enforcement, and supports audits through strong traceability and documentation.

We’re looking for a Senior Red Team Operator to join a skilled, close-knit team that genuinely loves this work. • Demonstrated ability to solve complex and challenging technical problems.

As an Operational Food Safety Technologist, you will act as a champion for food safety, quality, legality and compliance across our food operations. Working closely with operational teams, engineering, hygiene and pest control partners, you will help ensure products are produced to specification, food safety standards are consistently met, and any risks are identified and resolved quickly. • Working collaboratively with engineering, hygiene, pest control and operational teams to ensure food safety controls are maintained following planned and reactive works.

You will have the confidence to make informed decisions, influence best practice and uphold the highest standards of food safety and compliance. With a proactive and hands-on approach, you will be comfortable identifying areas for improvement and driving positive change. You will also be highly organised, able to prioritise effectively and committed to delivering exceptional standards at all times.

• A Food Safety Level 3 qualification.
• Previous experience in a Food Technologist role within hospitality, food production or manufacturing environments.

Passion and enthusiasm for the role and the company, capable of motivating and inspiring others.

This role is here to grow the business. You'll explore incremental or new revenue opportunities from across our products and propositions, then shape and help build the things that get us there.
You'll start with getting close to the market. You'll talk to customers and brokers, and work out why they buy: what they're trying to solve, which benefits actually matter, and where our own processes are quietly costing us business. You'll pair that with the data, pulling apart customer behaviour, pipeline and market numbers to see what's really happening rather than what everyone assumes. Our data isn't always tidy, so you'll need to be comfortable getting into it, structuring it and finding the signals yourself.
Mapping a journey properly, designing an experience that is good in practice internally and externally, building a case that stands up to challenge: these are skills we want you to bring and to raise across the team. If you love the feeling of delivery, seeing the numbers change as much as solving how, this is a great fit for you. You'll be incredibly curious and creative, but as comfortable with a revenue target as a customer conversation. Signals we love also include if you've worked at start-up or scale-up pace and can navigate a large organisation and foster collaboration.

Job Description:
Start date: September 2027
Location: Filton, Bristol
Duration: 4 years and 3 months
University: Aston University
Degree: BSc Supply Chain Management with Procurement (Professional Practice)
Application closing date: Applications will be open until 4 January 2027. After this date, the advert will close once sufficient applications are received. Early submission is recommended.
We love your interest in joining Airbus! There is no limit on the number of positions you can apply for. However, please be aware that you can only progress in the selection process for one position at a time. We recommend reviewing all available opportunities and applying to those that best match your experience and aspirations.
Benefits:
Salary: £23,245
35 hours per week //  Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays // Pension // Success share // Plus many more flexible benefits!
About us:
Kickstart your career with an Airbus apprenticeship! Airbus UK design, manufacture and manage the supply chain for Wings, Landing Gear and Fuel Systems on all Airbus Commercial Aircraft. Wing manufacture is performed at the world class Broughton Production facility whilst design and supply chain management is based in Filton, Bristol.
Components and parts are delivered from a global supply chain managed from the UK for onward delivery to Final Assembly Lines located in France, Germany, USA, Canada and China. Around 80% of Airbus’ activity is sourced. Working with more than 12,000 suppliers worldwide that provide products and services for flying and non-flying parts, joining the Supply Chain team will put you at the heart of Airbus where you will operate in a truly international environment. To manage all of this the Airbus Supply Chain function is diverse in its activities and the apprenticeship programme provides you the opportunity to experience different roles across the business.
You will receive second to none training to gain the skills and experience needed for immediate impact. You will also be supported by dedicated placement managers and an apprentice ‘buddy’ to help you along your development journey.
What you will be doing:
This apprenticeship offers an end-to-end understanding of the supply chain through rotational placements in Commercial (Flying Parts) Procurement, General Procurement, Supply Chain Operations, with potential opportunities for international work.
This 4 year, 3 month degree apprenticeship at our Filton, Bristol site offers professional experience and a BSc in Supply Chain Management with Procurement (Professional Practice) from Aston University. You will study via block release and dedicated study time while gaining on-the-job training. We prioritise your professional growth with ongoing development opportunities throughout the programme.
Your role will be varied, developing your skills in all elements of supplier management, negotiation and contract management all whilst working with a diverse range of stakeholders from across the business, as well as Airbus suppliers. Your work-based projects will underpin your learning and ensure you develop yourself through practical application of university study.
In addition to your work placements and studies, there are opportunities to join a wide variety of employee networks including a dedicated Early Careers network, Generation Airbus, Pride@Airbus, Balance for Business, Breathe and embRACE to help you develop both your professional and personal skills along the way. You will also be supported by like minded apprentices, other Early Careers and members of senior management.
Requirements:
We are looking for curious and driven individuals with a desire to launch their career in Supply Chain, and build an understanding of the wider Airbus business. No previous procurement/supply chain experience is required. To be successful, you will need to be comfortable with communicating with a wide range of people and proactively collaborate within and beyond your placement teams to benefit from opportunities and implement solutions successfully.

● 3 A Levels – a minimum of two Bs and one C, or equivalent subject to validation;
AND
● Minimum GCSE Grade C/4 or above in Mathematics and English Language.
*A-levels in Business, Economics or Maths would be an advantage but not essential.
Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate the following:
● Submit your CV stating your grades and if they are predicted or achieved;
● Submit a Cover Letter highlighting your passion and suitability for this apprenticeship.

Why Airbus and this apprenticeship?
What is it about Airbus that makes you excited to start a career with us? What is it about our company, our values, or the future of aerospace that excites you? We want to hear about what motivates you to pursue this unique path and how you see yourself growing with us.

Big responsibility. Personal support. That’s Beyond the Ordinary.
Want to get stuck into client work, tackle complex problems and build your career in Tax? Welcome to the Tax Graduate Programme at BDO.

A bit about Tax
BDO’s Tax practice spans 13 specialist areas, including Employment Tax, Private Client and Tax Dispute Resolution. Our tax professionals work with clients ranging from FTSE 100 companies to high-growth start-ups, giving you the chance to build experience across different businesses and challenges.
You’ll get involved in dynamic work and take on more responsibility as your confidence grows. And you’ll have people around you to help – from teammates and managers to directors and partners who can share their experience, answer questions and support your development.

Over three years, you’ll gain hands-on experience while studying towards ACA/CTA, ATT/CTA (tax pathway) qualifications. You’ll work alongside experienced professionals, developing your technical knowledge through client work while building your commercial skills and confidence.

When you successfully complete the programme and pass the exams, you’ll be fully qualified as a tax advisor, and guaranteed a permanent role with us.
As for you
You’re inquisitive, resilient and motivated. You enjoy solving problems, thinking things through and learning something new.
You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. Bring your curiosity, logical mindset and willingness to get involved, and you’ll have the support and experience to develop from there.
Join us in Gatwick, Guildford, Reading or Southampton hubs.

• A minimum 2:2 degree in any discipline (obtained or predicted)

• Commitment to balance study and professional work
• The right to work in the UK (we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for these roles as they do not meet the current minimum salary requirements for sponsorship set by the Home Office. Applications from candidates who have their own legal right to work within the UK must cover the duration of their 3-year training contract and employment)
How the interview process will go
We want you to know what to expect, so here’s the typical process:
• Online application form.
• Online assessments.
• Video interview.
• Virtual assessment centre.
• Final interview in person.
We’ll keep you updated at each stage and share tips to help you prepare. And just so you know: we don’t use AI in any part of our candidate screening process. Every application is reviewed by a real person.
What you get in return
Our benefits are designed to support your life in and outside of work, with options including additional leave, gym membership and employee discounts, alongside pension, health and wellbeing support and a range of protection benefits.
Salary
£30,000 - £32,000 per annum depending on location
Closing date for applications is Sunday 15th November 2026
Before you go
Wherever you join BDO, you’ll have the chance to learn by doing, work with clients and build your career with people around you to support your development.
The opportunity to build your experience, confidence and career without having to do it alone.
Big responsibility. Personal support.
That’s Beyond the Ordinary.
Apply now.

The Account Enablement Analyst plays a key role in supporting Capital Group's growth initiatives by helping ensure operational readiness for new accounts, products, markets, brokers, and trading capabilities.
Working across Core Operations, the Investment Group, Global Investment Control, Trading, custodians, brokers, and other internal and external partners, this role coordinates onboarding and enablement activities, identifies and resolves operational challenges, and supports the delivery of scalable solutions that enable investment activity.
As Account Enablement continues to evolve, the analyst will contribute across multiple enablement disciplines, including account onboarding, market opening, market and broker readiness, trading system setup, and derivatives onboarding. The role requires strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and a willingness to challenge existing processes while helping build scalable capabilities that support Capital Group's future operating model.
The successful candidate combines operational excellence, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills to deliver efficient, controlled, and scalable solutions that support investment activity, client outcomes, and the continued growth and evolution of the Account Enablement function.
What Success Looks Like
Successful Account Enablement Analysts are naturally curious, take ownership of outcomes, build trusted relationships, and navigate ambiguity with confidence. They combine strong operational execution with sound judgment, helping deliver scalable solutions that support investment activity and positive client outcomes while continuously improving how work gets done.
Key Responsibilities
Account & Operational Enablement
•
Support onboarding activities for new accounts, mandates, products, derivative products, and operational capabilities.
•
Partner with stakeholders to understand operational requirements, dependencies, risks, and readiness considerations associated with onboarding activities.
•
Coordinate readiness activities across multiple stakeholder groups to ensure successful implementation.
•
Assist with account funding, operational setup, maintenance activities, and lifecycle events.
•
Support operational setup, onboarding, and readiness activities associated with trading systems, derivative products, and collateral accounts.
•
Coordinate testing and validation of system changes and onboarding requirements.
•
Ensure relevant systems, controls, and documentation remain accurate and current.
Market & Broker Readiness
•
Support market opening and maintenance activities across global markets.
•
Coordinate operational requirements with custodians, brokers, and internal teams.
•
Maintain and monitor market documentation, settlement instructions, and supporting records.
•
Assist with broker onboarding and readiness activities required to support investment activity.
•
Partner with stakeholders to resolve market access and operational readiness issues.
Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement
•
Investigate operational issues and coordinate resolution activities across teams.
•
Gather and analyse information to identify root causes and recommend practical solutions.
•
Communicate risks, impacts, and proposed approaches clearly to stakeholders.
•
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance scalability.
•
Support automation, workflow simplification, and process improvement initiatives.
•
Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of onboarding processes, controls, and scalable operating models across Account Enablement.
•
Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational activities while maintaining an appropriate control environment.
Relationship Management & Collaboration
•
Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
•
Partner effectively across regions, functions, and diverse perspectives to deliver business and client-focused outcomes.
•
Contribute positively to an inclusive, collaborative team culture that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
•
Support cross-training efforts that enhance team resiliency and coverage, and team development.
What You Will Bring
Successful candidates will typically demonstrate a combination of the following:
•
Experience within investment operations, financial services, account onboarding, trading support, custody, or related operational functions.
•
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
•
Ability to manage multiple priorities and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment.
•
Effective stakeholder management, collaboration, and communication skills.
•
Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and sound judgment.
•
Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.
•
Experience with operational readiness, onboarding, market enablement, trading operations, process improvement, automation, or related activities is beneficial.
